en: ...Yes, you're right.
Irene (2nd Meeting, Male Angel
Hmm, sounds like something he'd say. Well, I made up my mind, didn't I? So I have to do it.
Besides, there's my sister too...
Have you found out anything?
But I'm sure we'll find some clue...
We'll find her for sure... That's what I believe, Fein.
Hmm, so that's what ＄＄＄＄＄＄ says. ＄＄＄＄＄＄ is so earnest, it makes me feel I have to do my best too.
For all that, it sounds like you say some pretty harsh things.
Really? Isn't that normal?
Well, don't go saying things that give ＄＄＄＄＄＄ too much trouble.
...Have you found out anything about Serenis?
No. Nothing yet...
Fein, did you find anything out?
...Yes, I saw Serenis.
Where? What was she doing?
She was with the imperial army that invaded Ecclesia...
Why... would my sister...
I don't know... Maybe she's lost her old memories...
Does my sister have something to do with what the Empire is doing now?
Probably... though I don't know the details...
I'll see her once more... And I mean to right my mistake...
I'm sorry... all of the blame is mine...
I swear I'll atone for that sin.
Pillar of Light
...Fein.
Serenis... we meet at last.
Hmph... so you're not dead yet.
...I have to stop you.
Hahaha, stop me? I won't let you do any such thing.
Serenis!
Stay right there and keep still, Fein.
Serenis...
Fein... let it end now...
...Yes... Serenis.
Ngh...
Serenis...?
Let it... end now... Fein...
Yes... Serenis.
Fein...
...Did Serenis suffer?
No... at the end, the devil that tormented her was driven out... and she was herself again...
To the very end, my sister loved you, Fein...
I've... lost any way to atone for my sin...
...Fein... it's over... No one can undo the past...
Please, Fein... look forward now...
I can never forget the suffering Serenis went through, or Zig's regret...
It hurts me too...
But there's nothing we can do about it now! Grandpa and Sissy aren't coming back...
So... all we can do is live our own lives...!
Fein... please...
Meeting After the Letter Event
Irene, about the letter, I'm sorry...
I... still can't forget the past...
No, I don't intend to ever forget this pain.
But even so, I think going on living is the one thing I can do.
Thank you, Irene. You're the one who taught me that.
I'll always care for you as my little sister.
Let me do something a big brother would do.
Okay. Once we're back at the tower...
Let's set the world right and go home, no matter what...
Yes, we'll go home, no matter what...
Viper?
Before you ask a guy's name, you oughta give yours first.
I am Fein, a Warlock.
I'll have back the Demon Stone you stole.
Oh ho. I've gotten pretty famous.
Even got a mage chasing after me...
I don't know how much you were paid, but if that Demon Stone reaches the Empire, it will drive the world mad.
You'll return it here and now.
Drive the world mad, huh... Not bad at all. That's the stuff of dreams.
Not something you get to see every day.
Don't mess with me...
Ooh, scary. Can't you take a joke?
Fine, I didn't know it was such a scary thing.
I'll give it back. To the angel, that is.
You... why?
Hm? Oh, 'cause the Empire's witch told me never to hand it to an angel.
I heard about you heroes, too.
The angel's here too, ain't they?
You are Fein Lu Lugus, aren't you?
And you are?
I am Diana. We met in the Forest of Reyforia, when I was the Holy Mother.
? The one I met was an old woman...
The Holy Mother you met entrusted her memories to me and passed away...
I am Diana, and I am also Cecia, who serves the same angel as you.
Such a thing is possible...? A strange power...
This is the Holy Mother's power. To preserve the memories of the ancient heroes forever.
The memories of the ancient heroes...?
Are you saying the legendary battle with the Heavenly Dragon will happen again?
Yes, probably... As things are, I do not think it can be avoided.
So the Demon Stones are being gathered for that after all...
Yes, to revive the Heavenly Dragon, no doubt.
And if we must fight the Heavenly Dragon, whether we can win again this time... that I cannot say.
But in this battle, we will not be fighting the Heavenly Dragon alone.
The evil power has spawned many enemies besides the Heavenly Dragon. We must defeat every one of them...
It will be hard, I think, but let us join forces and fight together.
Yes... In the battles ahead, please take good care of yourself as well...
Thank you, Fein... You too...
Ravenruft Battle (Midboss)
King of the vampires, Ravenruft.
Today I will put an end to your blood, which defiles the world.
I grant you your courage. But to think courage alone can defeat me is a mistake.
Learn how powerless you are!
Ravenruft Battle (Hero Dies)
Angel, do you understand now? Your own hypocrisy! It was you who killed this hero!!
But this is not the extent of my power...
Alberic Battle
The Empire's outrages... I'll end them by defeating you.
Howl all you like. Against my sword, you are no more than a babe...
This sword rejoices too... It says the blood of the angel's hero is the finest...
You destroyed the Guild and killed my comrades. I won't forgive you...
Hmph... Rejoice, for you have become nourishment for my sword and soul...
Mages are a lot nobody cares about, alive or dead, aren't they...
You are... the angel's hero Serenis spoke of...
The witch who gave me this armor... but I'll tell you no more...
There's no use telling anything to a man who's about to die...
Ngh, nnngh...
What did you gain by selling your soul to a devil?
Hmph... I didn't gain a thing.
I sold out the world 'cause I felt like it.
This world ain't worth much, you know.
It won't go like last time. No matter how fast you run.
Hmph, I ain't running. I can't let the likes of you get in the way of my last bit of fun.
No, you're wrong. I came here to defeat you.
I don't intend to listen to a devil's words any longer.
Here I come...
Fein!!
...This is...
Village Man
That uniform! Might you be a knight of the Empire, my lady?
Yes, I am... Why?
Oh no, it's nothing much, I just wondered whether you'd decided on an inn for tonight...
No, not especially...
Is that so! Then by all means, please stay at our inn!
If a knight of the Empire stays with us, it'll raise our inn's standing!
Well...
Come, come, before the night grows late!!
Ah, um...
Why are you doing this?! Who gave the order?!
Who are you? And isn't that uniform an imperial knight's?
If you're with the Empire, you should understand what we're doing. Or do you mean to defy us?
Yes... if you're dragging innocent people into this.
Hmph! Interesting... Let's see if you can fight in a way worthy of that uniform!!
Soldier (Still)
What is the meaning of my unit's advance being delayed?
You are... Leyla Vigrid? I'm sure you were stripped of your rank and honor as a knight...
This invasion goes against the pride of our Empire!
What pride of the Empire?!!
You're wounding soldiers of your own country. A traitor like you has no right to speak of our nation's pride!
A traitor can be killed without a second thought... I'll avenge my men!
You're...?!
Captain! Are you all right?
You all... why...
We saw you, Captain, so we followed you.
After you went missing, Captain, all sorts of rumors spread, but we still believe in you!
Besides, this kind of invasion isn't what our nation truly wants. Please don't lose heart.
We'll clear up the misunderstanding about you, Captain, so that someday you can go home!!
Everyone... thank you...
We'd like to talk more, but it's dangerous here. Quickly, get somewhere safe!
Yes... everyone, thank you, truly. Take care of yourselves too!
Yes, ma'am!
Village Woman
Boy
Ngh... was I too late...? Does the Empire mean to repeat history...?
